description: The plot titled “Massive Activation of atten_output_gate” illustrates how maximum activation values vary across model layers for four signals. The x-axis is labeled “Layer,” uses a linear scale, and spans approximately 0 to 23 with tick labels at regular intervals of 5 (0, 5, 10, 15, 20). The y-axis is labeled “Max Activation Value,” uses a linear scale, and ranges from 0 to 400 with tick labels every 50. Four lines are shown: a blue dashed line with small markers labeled “attn_output,” which stays low (near 0–10) through most layers and rises late to roughly 80–100 by the final layers; an orange dashed line with small markers labeled “attn_residual,” which increases gradually from near 0 to around 20–30 by mid layers and ends around roughly 60–80; a green dashed line with small markers labeled “ffn_output,” which remains near 0–10 for most layers and increases near the end to around 80–100; and a red solid line labeled “ffn_residual,” which climbs steadily from near 0 in early layers to about 50–70 by around layer 10, then accelerates sharply after the late teens, reaching roughly 150–200 near layer ~21 and peaking close to 380–400 at the final layer.
